metadata.name: FCRA credit reporting dispute reinvestigation candidate

extras.legal_scope_note: This is an engineering benchmark, not legal advice and not a complete FCRA compliance program. It models selected public-law duties for consumer reporting agency disputes, furnisher indirect disputes, furnisher direct disputes, reseller routing, reinsertion, consumer statements, and routing review triggers.

extras.purpose: Deep, realistic credit-reporting dispute benchmark for testing governed Map plus deterministic RuleKit execution against direct LLM disposition.

n_consideration_satisfied.surface_label: CRA consideration satisfied or not required

n_defect_furnisher.surface_label: furnisher corrected defective information after indirect dispute

n_defect_treatment.surface_label: defect corrected by deletion or modification

n_direct_defect_path.surface_label: direct dispute corrected with required process

n_direct_no_defect_path.surface_label: direct dispute verified with required process

n_friv_notice_timely.surface_label: frivolous notice within five business days

n_furnisher_action.surface_label: furnisher corrected or blocked defective item

n_furnisher_indirect_satisfied.surface_label: furnisher indirect duties satisfied or not applicable

n_id_theft_missing_report.surface_label: identity theft claim lacks required report

n_no_defect_furnisher.surface_label: furnisher verified no defect after indirect dispute

n_notify_within_5.surface_label: furnisher notice within five business days

n_reinsert_notice_within_5.surface_label: reinsertion notice within five business days

n_reinv_timely.surface_label: reinvestigation timing satisfied or not required

n_reseller_convey_within_5.surface_label: reseller conveyance within five business days

n_reseller_forward_path.surface_label: reseller forwarded source CRA dispute and reconveyed results

n_reseller_satisfied.surface_label: reseller obligations satisfied or not applicable

n_results_within_5.surface_label: results notice within five business days

fcra.account_identified.statement: The disputed account or tradeline is identified.

fcra.additional_relevant_info_received_i.statement: The consumer provided additional relevant information during the initial 30-day period.

fcra.automated_code_only.statement: The investigation consisted only of automated dispute coding without meaningful document review.

fcra.basis_explained.statement: The dispute explains the basis for the claimed inaccuracy or incompleteness.

fcra.business_days_to_frivolous_notice.statement: Business days from frivolous or irrelevant determination to consumer notice.

fcra.business_days_to_notify_furnisher.statement: Business days from CRA receipt of dispute to furnisher notice.

fcra.business_days_to_reinsertion_notice.statement: Business days from reinsertion to consumer notice.

fcra.business_days_to_reseller_conveyanc.statement: Business days from reseller receipt to conveyance to the CRA.

fcra.business_days_to_results_notice.statement: Business days from reinvestigation completion to results notice.

fcra.conflicting_furnisher_and_consumer_.statement: Furnisher records and consumer primary documents materially conflict.

fcra.consumer_alleges_not_mine.statement: The consumer alleges the disputed account or item is not theirs.

fcra.consumer_authorized_representative.statement: Any representative submitting the dispute is authorized by the consumer.

fcra.consumer_identity_sufficient.statement: The packet contains sufficient consumer identity information to investigate.

fcra.consumer_info_dispositive.statement: Consumer-submitted information is dispositive or potentially dispositive of the dispute.

fcra.consumer_statement_filed.statement: The consumer filed a brief statement of dispute after reinvestigation did not resolve the dispute.

fcra.consumer_statement_right_disclosed.statement: The results notice disclosed the right to add a consumer statement.

fcra.consumer_submission_authentic.statement: The dispute submission appears authentic to the consumer or authorized representative.

fcra.consumer_telephone_notice_of_expedi.statement: The consumer received prompt telephone notice of expedited deletion.

fcra.court_order_supplied.statement: The consumer supplied a court order material to the disputed reporting.

fcra.cra_checked_prior_dispute_history.statement: The CRA checked prior dispute history where relevant.

fcra.cra_checked_public_record_source.statement: The CRA checked the public-record source where public-record data was material.

fcra.cra_compared_furnisher_response.statement: The CRA compared the furnisher response against the consumer's dispute basis.

fcra.cra_compared_own_file.statement: The CRA compared the dispute against its own file contents.

fcra.cra_considered_primary_source_docum.statement: The CRA considered primary source documents submitted by the consumer.

fcra.cra_notified_furnisher.statement: The consumer reporting agency notified the furnisher of the dispute.

fcra.cra_reasonable_reinvestigation_perf.statement: The CRA performed a reasonable reinvestigation of the disputed item.

fcra.cra_received_dispute_date_known.statement: The consumer reporting agency's dispute receipt date is known.

fcra.cra_resolved_internal_inconsistency.statement: The CRA resolved material internal inconsistencies in its file or processing records.

fcra.cra_reviewed_all_consumer_info.statement: The CRA reviewed all relevant information submitted by the consumer.

fcra.days_to_complete_reinvestigation.statement: Calendar days from dispute receipt to reinvestigation completion.

fcra.days_to_furnisher_complete.statement: Calendar days from CRA dispute notice to furnisher completion of required investigation, review, and reports.

fcra.days_to_reseller_correct_delete.statement: Days from reseller receipt to correction or deletion by reseller.

fcra.days_to_send_procedure_description.statement: Days from procedure-description request to description sent.

fcra.deleted_item_reappeared_without_cer.statement: Deleted information reappeared without required furnisher certification.

fcra.direct_dispute_at_proper_address.statement: The direct dispute was sent to a proper furnisher dispute address.

fcra.direct_dispute_explains_basis.statement: The direct dispute explains the basis for the dispute.

fcra.direct_dispute_fraud_alert_only.statement: The direct dispute concerns only fraud alerts or active duty alerts outside direct-furnisher dispute scope.

fcra.direct_dispute_identifies_account.statement: The direct dispute identifies the account or relationship in dispute.

fcra.direct_dispute_identifies_specific_.statement: The direct dispute identifies the specific information being disputed.

fcra.direct_dispute_public_record_only.statement: The direct dispute concerns only public-record information outside direct-furnisher dispute scope.

fcra.direct_dispute_received_by_furnishe.statement: The furnisher received a direct dispute notice from the consumer.

fcra.direct_dispute_subject_within_scope.statement: The direct dispute concerns covered account or relationship information bearing on creditworthiness or similar attributes.

fcra.direct_dispute_supporting_docs_supp.statement: The consumer supplied supporting documentation reasonably required by the furnisher.

fcra.direct_furnisher_corrected_cras.statement: The furnisher notified CRAs and provided corrections when the direct investigation found reported information inaccurate.

fcra.direct_furnisher_investigation_cond.statement: The furnisher conducted a reasonable investigation of a qualifying direct dispute.

fcra.direct_furnisher_results_reported_t.statement: The furnisher reported direct-dispute investigation results to the consumer within the applicable period.

fcra.direct_furnisher_reviewed_info.statement: The furnisher reviewed all relevant information provided by the consumer with the direct dispute notice.

fcra.dispositive_info_not_ignored.statement: Dispositive or potentially dispositive consumer information was not ignored.

fcra.dispute_about_accuracy.statement: The dispute concerns accuracy of the item.

fcra.dispute_about_completeness.statement: The dispute concerns completeness of the item.

fcra.dispute_duplicate_without_new_info.statement: The dispute is substantially the same as a prior dispute and contains no new required information.

fcra.dispute_not_credit_repair_org_form.statement: The direct furnisher dispute was not submitted by or on a form supplied by a credit repair organization.

fcra.disputed_field_identified.statement: The specific disputed field or information is identified.

fcra.expedited_deleted_within_3_business.statement: The dispute was resolved by deletion within 3 business days after receipt.

fcra.expedited_written_confirmation_sent.statement: Written confirmation and a revised report were sent after expedited deletion.

fcra.frivolous_determination_made.statement: The institution determined the dispute was frivolous or irrelevant.

fcra.frivolous_missing_info_identified.statement: The frivolous or irrelevant notice identified information required to investigate.

fcra.frivolous_notice_sent.statement: Notice of the frivolous or irrelevant determination was sent to the consumer.

fcra.frivolous_reason_identified.statement: The frivolous or irrelevant notice identified the reasons for the determination.

fcra.furnished_by_furnisher.statement: The disputed item was provided by a furnisher.

fcra.furnisher_address_available.statement: The furnisher address or notification mechanism is available.

fcra.furnisher_blocked_item.statement: The furnisher permanently blocked reporting of the disputed information.

fcra.furnisher_certified_accuracy_for_re.statement: The furnisher certified the reinserted information as complete and accurate.

fcra.furnisher_contact_disclosed_if_avai.statement: The procedure-right notice includes furnisher contact information when reasonably available.

fcra.furnisher_deleted_item.statement: The furnisher deleted the disputed information for reporting purposes.

fcra.furnisher_investigation_conducted.statement: The furnisher conducted an investigation of the disputed information.

fcra.furnisher_modified_item.statement: The furnisher modified the disputed information for reporting purposes.

fcra.furnisher_received_cra_notice.statement: The furnisher received CRA notice of the consumer dispute.

fcra.furnisher_reported_inaccuracy_to_ot.statement: The furnisher reported incomplete or inaccurate findings to other nationwide CRAs to which it furnished the information.

fcra.furnisher_reported_results_to_cra.statement: The furnisher reported investigation results to the CRA.

fcra.furnisher_reviewed_all_cra_info.statement: The furnisher reviewed all relevant information provided by the CRA.

fcra.human_review_of_documents_performed.statement: A human or equivalent document-review process evaluated material primary documents.

fcra.identity_theft_claimed.statement: The consumer claims the disputed item resulted from identity theft.

fcra.identity_theft_report_supplied.statement: The consumer supplied an identity theft report or equivalent identity theft documentation.

fcra.info_found_inaccurate_during_30_day.statement: The item was found inaccurate during the initial 30-day period.

fcra.info_found_incomplete_during_30_day.statement: The item was found incomplete during the initial 30-day period.

fcra.info_unverifiable_during_30_days.statement: The item was determined unverifiable during the initial 30-day period.

fcra.insufficient_information_to_investi.statement: The consumer failed to provide sufficient information to investigate the disputed information.

fcra.item_cannot_be_verified.statement: The disputed item could not be verified.

fcra.item_deleted.statement: The disputed item was deleted from the consumer's file.

fcra.item_found_inaccurate.statement: The reinvestigation found the disputed item inaccurate.

fcra.item_found_incomplete.statement: The reinvestigation found the disputed item incomplete.

fcra.item_in_consumer_file.statement: The disputed item is contained in the consumer's file at a consumer reporting agency.

fcra.item_modified.statement: The disputed item was modified as appropriate.

fcra.item_reinserted.statement: Previously deleted information was reinserted into the consumer's file.

fcra.item_status_recorded_current.statement: The current status of the disputed information was recorded.

fcra.item_verified_as_accurate.statement: The disputed item was verified as complete and accurate after reasonable reinvestigation.

fcra.later_relevant_info_forwarded.statement: Later relevant information was promptly provided to the furnisher.

fcra.later_relevant_info_received.statement: Additional relevant information was received from the consumer after furnisher notice and before the reinvestigation deadline.

fcra.legal_liability_dispute_only.statement: The dispute turns only on legal liability rather than objectively verifiable factual reporting.

fcra.manual_review_policy_trigger.statement: The institution's manual review policy is triggered by the dispute packet.

fcra.material_date_conflict.statement: Material dates in the dispute record conflict.

fcra.medical_debt_veteran_claimed.statement: The dispute claims veteran medical-debt treatment may apply.

fcra.mixed_file_claimed.statement: The consumer claims the report mixed another person's information into the consumer's file.

fcra.notice_direct_to_cra.statement: The consumer notified the consumer reporting agency directly.

fcra.notice_included_all_relevant_info.statement: The CRA's furnisher notice included all relevant information received from the consumer.

fcra.notice_states_reinvestigation_compl.statement: The results notice states that the reinvestigation is completed.

fcra.notice_through_reseller.statement: The consumer notified the consumer reporting agency indirectly through a reseller.
fcra.notice_through_reseller.notes: Applies when a reseller forwards the dispute.

fcra.notification_right_disclosed.statement: The results notice disclosed the right to request notifications of deletion or dispute notation.

fcra.pending_litigation_affects_account.statement: Pending litigation materially affects the disputed account reporting.

fcra.primary_documents_forwarded.statement: Primary source documents submitted by the consumer were forwarded or made available to the furnisher.

fcra.procedure_description_requested.statement: The consumer requested a description of the reinvestigation procedure used.

fcra.procedure_description_right_disclos.statement: The results notice disclosed the right to request the procedure used.

fcra.procedure_description_sent.statement: The CRA sent the requested description of the reinvestigation procedure.

fcra.procedures_prevent_reappearance.statement: The CRA maintained reasonable procedures designed to prevent improper reappearance of deleted information.

fcra.reinsertion_notice_identifies_furni.statement: The reinsertion notice identified the furnisher's business name and address if reasonably available.

fcra.reinsertion_notice_includes_stateme.statement: The reinsertion notice told the consumer of the right to add a statement.

fcra.reinsertion_notice_sent.statement: Written notice of reinsertion was sent to the consumer.

fcra.reinvestigation_completed.statement: The consumer reporting agency completed the reinvestigation.

fcra.reseller_conveyed_to_cra.statement: The reseller conveyed the dispute and all relevant information to the source CRA.

fcra.reseller_corrected_or_deleted.statement: The reseller corrected or deleted information caused by its act or omission.

fcra.reseller_item_due_to_reseller_error.statement: The incomplete or inaccurate item resulted from an act or omission of the reseller.

fcra.reseller_received_dispute.statement: A reseller received the consumer dispute.

fcra.reseller_reconveyed_results_to_cons.statement: The reseller reconveyed the CRA completion notice to the consumer.

fcra.reseller_reinvestigation_chosen.statement: The reseller elected to conduct its own reinvestigation.

fcra.results_notice_sent.statement: The CRA sent written reinvestigation results to the consumer.

fcra.revised_consumer_report_provided.statement: The results notice included a consumer report based on the revised file.

fcra.source_documents_missing.statement: Material source documents needed to resolve the dispute are missing from the packet.

fcra.subsequent_reports_note_dispute.statement: Subsequent reports containing the information clearly note the consumer's dispute and statement or summary.

fcra.consumer_statement_satisfied.description: Consumer statement handling is satisfied or not applicable.

fcra.cra_consideration_satisfied.description: CRA consideration and reasonableness duties are satisfied.

fcra.cra_furnisher_notice_satisfied.description: CRA furnisher-notice transmission duties are satisfied.

fcra.cra_reinvestigation_required.description: The CRA is required to conduct a reinvestigation.

fcra.cra_reinvestigation_trigger_valid.description: A valid CRA reinvestigation trigger exists.

fcra.direct_furnisher_satisfied.description: Furnisher direct-dispute duties are satisfied or not applicable.

fcra.dispute_resolution_compliant.description: Selected credit-reporting dispute obligations are satisfied.

fcra.frivolous_termination_valid.description: Any frivolous or irrelevant termination is valid.

fcra.furnisher_indirect_satisfied.description: Furnisher duties after CRA notice are satisfied or not applicable.

fcra.human_review_required.description: The packet requires human review routing.

fcra.item_treatment_satisfied.description: Inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable information is treated correctly.

fcra.reinsertion_satisfied.description: Reinsertion safeguards are satisfied or not applicable.

fcra.reseller_satisfied.description: Reseller dispute duties are satisfied or not applicable.

fcra.results_notice_satisfied.description: CRA results notice duties are satisfied.
